scope: c control-path timing pipeline only; production sources untouched
changes: Context operands are captured at control acceptance before arithmetic/comparison.
CONTROL_EXEC registers the 41-bit ALU result or 22-bit workspace address.
CONTROL_COMMIT preserves all existing field legality, overflow, context-width, height/mode and RAM bounds checks before any write.
Branch compares registered operands in CONTROL_EXEC; its condition is registered before the existing control_done handshake.
SET, CALL, RET, INPUT, OUTPUT and WMOV retain the original immediate execution path.
Workspace LOAD read-address registration moves from FETCH to CONTROL_COMMIT, before CONTROL_LOAD; STORE uses the registered, fully checked address.
Sequencer is copied byte for byte, retaining token stability, PC/return/loop semantics and c layout4 ABI.

states.CONTROL_EXEC: reuses the previously unused CONTROL enum position40
states.CONTROL_COMMIT: appended after CONTROL_OUTPUT; existing live-state numeric values retained

estimated_cycle_delta.per_job: 2*(numeric controls excluding SET + LOAD + STORE) + BR, dynamic instruction counts; not yet measured

preserved: ROM contents/capacity and external module interfaces
hardware CHAIN and software TREE granularity

validation.scope: Targeted actual RTL control unit tests only; no complete-tree simulation, synthesis or route launched

timing_expectation: Splits group_index/FORS selector -> context mux -> ALU -> legal-result mask/check -> destination CE into separate register boundaries. No frequency closure or area improvement claimed before measurement.
